newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France no comment on intervention talk.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France no comment on intervention talk.

text.p: The Bank of France declined to comment on talk among some foreign exchange traders that it had intervened to support the French franc.
"The Bank of France does not comment on rumours," a Bank of France spokesman said on Monday.

The French franc fell to 3.3860 per mark, its lowest level this year, after the Socialist-led left swept to power in a parilamentary election on Sunday, before recovering to trade at 3.3842 at 0856 GMT.
A trader at a French bank said he thought the zone between 3.3850/60 was "relatively protected this morning".

Some bond traders said there was talk of state-owned insitutional investors supporting the cash bond market early on Monday, although one said volumes were not that large and private investors were also buying bonds.
Traders in Singapore and Tokyo said earlier on Monday talk the French central bank had been buying francs had cushioned its decline after the election result.
